name: Please teach! My Angel
source:
Main character witnesses an angel coming down from the sky in a nearby park. She turns out to be a new teacher appointed from the heavens in order to qualify for heavens teacher in future. She proposes to live with protagonist in order to prevent her identity leak. With such angel older sister and pretty and obedient imouto their crazy life begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在附近的公園目睹一名天使從天而降。原來，她是由天界派來的新任教師，為了將來取得天界教師資格而來到人間實習。為了避免身分洩露，她提議與主角同住。就這樣，主角與天使大姊姊以及乖巧可愛的妹妹開始了熱熱鬧鬧的同居生活。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
